episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Erin's picturesque life takes a turn for the unexpected when she single-handedly subdues armed robbers in a supermarket stickup, stunning her daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Erin's nosy neighbor on the police force comes asking for assistance even as she tries to put on a happy face for her daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Erin scrambles to erase evidence of her actions, pulling her deeper into danger. Harper grows increasingly suspicious of her.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: A glimpse into Erin's past reveals how she arrived at motherhood and unveils the shocking secrets that she has been rushing to conceal.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: As Emilio closes in on crucial evidence, his investigation is averted. Erin is forced to fess up to her husband and daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: A ghost from Erin's past comes searching for her with a vengeance, putting her and her loved ones at risk.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Erin must team up with an unlikely partner to save what is most dear to her. A daring break in results in the ultimate sacrifice.
